scope: Phase 0.5 public-data transfer reference only; this contract does not define or imply a challenge model, endpoint mapping, or external-data permission.

model.training_split: none; all curated rows used for training

disclosures: The model card names the mutable main image. This attempt uses only the resolved digest above.
The resolved image embeds framework revision 6077d125, not stable tag v0.2.0 at cdf3e9f7; the container digest is authoritative for inference.
The framework pyproject declares MIT while the image metadata declares Apache-2.0; both notices remain disclosed.
The image is amd64 and will run under explicit emulation on the arm64 development host.

benchmark_input.preprocessing_disclosure: Inference uses the frozen cypshift standardized structure. The model was trained on OPENADMET_CANONICAL_SMILES, so canonicalization may differ. No raw-structure alternative will be scored.

tdc_cyp2c9_veith.polarity: higher predicted pIC50 ranks the positive inhibitor class higher

tdc_cyp2d6_veith.polarity: higher predicted pIC50 ranks the positive inhibitor class higher

tdc_cyp3a4_veith.polarity: higher predicted pIC50 ranks the positive inhibitor class higher

octant_cyp3a4_active_preincubation_pIC50.assay_disclosure: ChEMBL-trained pIC50 is transferred to the Octant active-enzyme preincubation assay; it is not a direct-inhibition or assay-equivalence claim.

overlap_audit.method: Apply rdkit-cleanup-fragment-parent-v1 to every published X_train.csv structure and compare exact standardized_structure_hash values with all 7724 frozen benchmark structures.
overlap_audit.official_population_policy: Preserve every official TDC test row and the complete Octant outer population, with exact training-overlap counts disclosed.
overlap_audit.companion_population_policy: For each TDC task exclude the union of the existing seven-row TDC strict set and exact CheMeleon-training overlaps. For Octant exclude exact CheMeleon-training overlaps.
overlap_audit.claim_boundary: Call the companion exact-structure-disjoint only. Do not call it clean zero-shot because analog and source-record overlap can remain.

attempt.definition: One digest-pinned CPU environment pull, one deterministic four-structure smoke probe, and two full label-absent inference runs. The full runs must produce byte-identical canonical predictions before scoring.
attempt.smoke_selection: Choose the lexicographically smallest held-out molecule_id from Octant and each of the three TDC tasks; do not use a label.
forbidden_remediation: a polarity flip after observing scores
threshold fitting, calibration, fine-tuning, stacking, or model selection

scoring.precondition: Two complete label-absent prediction roots are byte-identical and all source, input, output, row-alignment, finiteness, and overlap receipts pass.
scoring.label_access: Open the frozen held-out labels once after prediction freeze.
scoring.comparison_status: TDC official rows share the fixed split, population, and average-precision metric, but training source, label provenance, preprocessing, and any exact overlap are disclosed. Companion and Octant rows are transfer analyses and are not ranked against TDC anchors.

acceptance.retain_as_external_evidence_if: The exact checkpoint and environment complete aligned finite predictions twice within both budgets, the overlap audit is complete, and the one scoring pass produces all supported declared populations.
acceptance.performance_gate: None. Report the frozen result whether it is better or worse; never add this external model to the native ensemble in Phase 0.5.
acceptance.reject_if: Any provenance, environment, alignment, finiteness, repeatability, budget, or scoring precondition fails. Record the precise blocker and do not attempt another model or environment in this phase.

simplicity.implementation_shape: One focused label-absent preparation and prediction path, one scorer, files and receipts only.
